_comment: Optional hand-placed motion zones. Values are pixels, or fractions of the
image if every number in a rect is <= 1. Modes:
rotate_top - swings a rigid body around the TOP edge of its rect (hoop earrings,
dangling charms). Use the earring's attachment point as the top edge.
sway       - soft horizontal drift + slight vertical bob (bracelets, pendants,
glint      - the only non-warp effect: a faint moving highlight swept across the
rect (sunglass lenses, metal). Keep amplitude <= 0.04 to stay subtle.
amplitude: 1.0 = the calibrated default; cycles = full oscillations per loop (integer).
